strategy_portfolio.name: salience_first
strategy_portfolio.principle: try visually salient live candidates first without spending the whole budget on one coordinate.

strategy_portfolio.name: action_effect_memory
strategy_portfolio.principle: prefer candidates with observed or cached action-effect evidence.

strategy_portfolio.name: verifier_router_candidate_ranking
strategy_portfolio.principle: rank compatible candidates by verifier-style confidence with stable fallback order.

strategy_portfolio.name: conservative_reset_reinduction
strategy_portfolio.principle: reserve a small budget for reset or reinduction-safe candidates after local evidence stalls.
